questions.question: A student observes that a metal spoon feels colder than a wooden spoon in the same room. What best explains this?
options: Metal is always at a lower temperature
Metal conducts heat away from the hand faster
questions.explanation: Metal conducts heat more readily, so it draws heat from the hand faster.

questions.question: A shadow is shortest around noon on a sunny day because
options: The Sun is relatively high in the sky
The Sun turns off at noon
questions.explanation: A higher Sun angle produces a shorter shadow.

questions.question: Four seedlings receive equal water, soil and light, but one gets no light. Which comparison best tests light's effect?
options: Give each seedling different soil and water
Change the seed type every day
Measure only the colour of the pots
Compare the growth of the seedling kept without light with the others
questions.explanation: Keeping other factors similar makes the light comparison fair.

questions.question: A mixture contains rice grains, iron pins and salt. Which sequence is most suitable to separate all three?
options: Filter once and collect everything together
Use only a magnet to remove all three
Use a magnet for pins, sieve rice, then dissolve and evaporate salt solution
Freeze the mixture and shake it
questions.explanation: Magnetism separates iron, size can separate rice, and evaporation can recover dissolved salt.

questions.question: A toy car travels 12 m in 4 s and then 12 m in 2 s. During which part is it faster?
options: It is stationary in both parts
questions.explanation: The first speed is 3 m/s and the second is 6 m/s.

questions.question: A student sees a plant bend towards a window. This response is called
questions.explanation: Phototropism is plant growth in response to light direction.

questions.question: A torch beam is aimed at a wall. An opaque book is placed in the beam. What appears on the wall?
options: A dark shadow where light is blocked
questions.explanation: The book blocks light from reaching part of the wall.

questions.question: A compass needle changes direction near a bar magnet because
options: The magnet changes the air into water
The magnet exerts a magnetic force on the needle
The needle is attracted by sunlight
questions.explanation: A compass needle is magnetic and responds to nearby magnetic fields.

questions.question: A student wants to compare how quickly sugar dissolves in cold and warm water. Which is the fairest setup?
options: Use more sugar in the cold water
Use equal water volumes and sugar amounts, changing only water temperature
Use different cups with unknown volumes
questions.explanation: Changing only temperature allows a fair comparison of dissolving rate.

questions.question: Which conclusion is best after one seed fails to germinate?
options: One failure alone does not prove that the seed type can never germinate
All seeds of this type are dead
Water is never needed by seeds
The seed has become an animal
questions.explanation: A single result is not enough; check conditions and repeat with more seeds.
